task: Leg 2: short matched empty-domain control for registered energy and passivity invariants
input_basis: Unchanged parity.project_for empty family. Index 1 is the empty vacuum background, not a new device material. Mesh, duration and spectrum count are computational controls. All source wavelengths, positions, boundary conditions and monitor planes remain the copied adapter defaults.

invariants.basis: Absolute dimensionless error budget for float64 arithmetic in two independently executed identical empty-domain simulations with matched flux normalization. This is a normalization control, not a mesh-convergence or nontrivial scattering accuracy tolerance. Periodic transverse boundaries leave only the two x exits, both covered by existing full-span monitors.
Absolute dimensionless bound-violation budget for float64 roundoff in the same matched empty-domain control. All entries must also be finite; finiteness has no tolerance.

dropped_invariants.reason: Stop condition 1: the copied adapter has a one-way source, not a symmetric source with measured forward and backward emitted powers. Register a separate symmetric-source measurement step before using this check.
Stop condition 1: no exchanged-source/monitor paired measurement exists. Register a separate exchanged-port measurement step before using this check.
